specs.quote: Drying Settings before Printing Blast Drying Oven: 80 °C, 8 - 12 h
specs.note: Second TDS condition: "X1 Series Printer Heatbed: 90 - 100 °C, 12 h". The Support Filament Usage Guide (2.1) agrees: "PVA | 80℃, 8 - 12h | 90 - 100 °C, 12h | AMS 2Pro: 65°, 18h AMS HT: 85℃, 18h". The drying wiki (Appendix I) gives forced-air oven 75-85 ℃, 8-12 h; heatbed 90-100 ℃, 12 h; AMS 2 Pro not compatible; AMS HT 85 ℃, 18 h.
specs.conflict_note: The wiki material table (Storage and Material Specifications) gives PVA "55 ℃ for 8 h" in a blast drying oven, AMS 2 Pro "Not recommended", AMS HT "85 ℃ for 18 h"; this disagrees with the TDS 80 °C, 8-12 h (which the Support Filament Usage Guide repeats). The product TDS is kept.

documents.title: Bambu PVA Technical Data Sheet V1.0
Filament guide - Printer, Nozzle, AMS, Build Plate, Glue Compatibility and Required Parameters

notes: TDS mechanical properties (p.2): every row is "N/A" (Young's Modulus X-Y/Z, Tensile Strength X-Y/Z, Breaking Elongation Rate X-Y/Z, Bending Modulus X-Y/Z, Bending Strength X-Y/Z, Impact Strength X-Y/Z): recorded as not_published, never as 0.

TDS physical properties (p.2) "N/A": Glass Transition Temperature (DSC, 10 °C/min), Crystallization Temperature, Vicat Softening Temperature (ISO 306, GB/T 1633), Heat Deflection Temperature (ISO 75 1.8 MPa and 0.45 MPa).

TDS values with no registry key (not stored as specs): Printing and Storage Humidity < 20% RH (Sealed, with desiccant); Bed Surface Preparation Glue; Retraction Length 0.6 - 1.0 mm; Retraction Speed 20 - 40 mm/s; Max Overhang Angle 55 °; Max Bridging Length ~ 30 mm; Support Material "/"; Melt Index 7.2 ± 1.1 g/10 min (210 °C, 2.16 kg); Saturated Water Absorption Rate 6.25% (25 °C, 55% RH); Odor Odorless; Solubility Soluble in water; Resistance to Acid / Alkali Not resistant; Resistance to Organic Solvent Not resistant to some organic solvents; Resistance to Oil and Grease Resistant to most kinds of oil and grease; Flammability Flammable; Combustion Products Water, carbon oxides, etc.

SDS (p.3): hazard classification "Not classified" under (EC) No 1272/2008; p.13-14: not hazardous goods for IMDG, DOT, ADR/RID and ICAO/IATA; p.15: not listed as SVHC. No certification is stated in the SDS.

Wiki values with no registry key: PVA guide - in a 20% RH dry environment PVA stays dry about 1 to 3 days, at about 55% RH freshly dried PVA gets damp in about 1 to 3 hours; dissolve supports in water (warm water speeds it up; not above 50°C for PLA models); AMS HT drying mode around 80 °C (PVA guide) / around 85 °C (Support guide, H2D). Drying wiki: the static drying mode is not suitable for PVA.
The PVA Printing Guide drying table is an image (table.png): its values could not be read offline and are not used.
hex: none. The store page links no Hex Code document for PVA (docs-by-product: hex_not_linked_by_store_page) and none is cached; the colour "Clear (66400)" keeps its official swatch only.
in_the_box: none. No official in-the-box list for this product was among the documents.

safety.certifications: neither recorded nor marked not_published. The store page links "Filament RoHS" (https://store.bblcdn.com/s7/default/5a9005351ca8426b8fa2b1b61c8ef4fc/RoHS_report_Bambu_PVA.pdf), which was not cached and was not read.

Store page consistency: material.diameter 1.75 mm, material.diameter_tolerance 0.03 mm and material.net_weight 500 g (scope 0.5 kg) agree with the parsed page rows; material.density and print_settings.nozzle_temp replace the page's not_found rows. No curated value disagrees with a parsed page row.
